Kimberly Marso has been with LifeScape since 2002. She holds an undergraduate degree in Psychology/Special Education from the University of South Dakota and completed both a Master’s in Applied Behavior Analysis and a doctorate in Rehabilitation Administration from Southern Illinois University at Carbondale. She is a doctoral-level board-certified behavior analyst, credentialed through the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc.

Stephan A. Wilson, CPA, has held Chief Financial Officer positions with two community hospitals and a large Midwestern medical system. Besides being a Certified Public Accountant, he is a member of the Healthcare Financial Management Association and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Management and Accounting from Southern Adventist University in Tennessee. He joined the LifeScape organization in 2017.
